notes.title: Warmage is out now!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2648980/Warmage/

[h1]Warmage is out now![/h1]

It's good, you can finally play Warmage. It's a real pleasure to share this experience with you that I hope you'll enjoy.

A little reminder, Warmage is:
- 10 unique districts, each with its own unique challenges
- 12 starting classes that will bring great replayability
- 6 different disciples who will be able to accompany you
- 96 spells to strike harder and harder
- 55 objects that will allow you to survive

There you go, the city remains in danger and it's up to you to help your fellow citizens!
